item.title: European Nations Maintain World Cup Boycott, Pressuring FIFA's Infantino
item.description: The ongoing boycott threatens FIFA's stability and increases calls for President Gianni Infantino's resignation.

item.title: Sri Lanka Wildlife Park Offers Sanctuary for Elephants Amid Habitat Loss
item.description: Hurulu Eco Park provides a refuge for elephants as their natural habitats are converted to agriculture, reducing human-elephant conflict.

item.title: New flu vaccine for older adults expected soon
item.description: The first mRNA-based flu shot approved by the FDA will be available for the upcoming flu season. Moderna, the manufacturer, is preparing for distribution.

item.title: Park service says Trump's arch would block historic sites; relocation possible?
item.description: The National Park Service reports that President Trump's proposed arch in Memorial Circle would affect dozens of nearby historic sites. There has been little discussion about moving it.
